_doc: Manifest of every polishable UI surface in the Hack Arena SPA. 'screen' is logical (not 1:1 with a file); 'files' names the source files the polisher operates on, with optional grep anchors to scope edits. 'behaviour.also' lists secondary modules that co-own the surface. 'visual_anchor' is what the ui-visual-verifier screenshots (comma-separated alternatives allowed; empty => full viewport). 'auth' + 'route_script' describe how to reach the screen from a fresh context. A screen that cannot be captured at all carries 'status_note': "uncapturable" and a 'note' saying why; the harness SKIPS it by name and never shoots something else. Routes run the step language documented in tests/_ui-polish.spec.js (goto, apiLogin, waitFor, settle, wait, click, fill, press, select, tab, drawer, section, viewport, look, fixture, fillCode, clock, upload, settings, heading); fixtures live in tests/polish-fixtures/. Optional 'looks', 'modes' and 'widths' arrays narrow the capture matrix (POLISH_MATRIX) for one entry. Every dialog the SPA mounts (each overlayDismiss call, and each id a dialog factory such as users-admin.js _dialog is given) must lie in an entry's scope: a new dialog gets its own entry, or the owning entry's grep widens to reach it (lock: tests/functional-core-b.api.spec.js, "every dialog the SPA mounts…").
_a11y_floor: WCAG AA 4.5:1. The axe-core gate filters violations to impact in {moderate, serious, critical} with tags wcag2a+wcag2aa. VERIFY (.claude/commands/polish.md) runs the ui-admin and ui-participant axe specs and layout-integrity in the house look, plus the look and contrast locks (dark-theme-a11y's every-look sign-in scan, interactive-contrast across every look, mode and ambient colour, theme-tokens).

Module bodies are side-effect-free; all boot wiring lives in core/main.js boot(). public/help.js, public/help-renderer.js, public/theme-boot.js and public/asset-versions.js are standalone CLASSIC scripts, outside the module graph.
_admin_nav_note: The admin view uses a left sidebar (#admin-sidebar) of .admin-nav-item buttons in three groups, NOT tabs; Submissions and Logs have no item (the workspace's Activity section and Audit's Raw logs switch). Route with `tab <slug>` (button.admin-nav-item[data-tab-id="admin-<slug>-tab"], opening the phone drawer when the sidebar is hidden) and an open workspace's sections with `section <data-section>`; never by label text (the manifest lock refuses it: labels are copy).
